name: Gian-carlo'S LUCKY HAPPY LIFE
source:
Gian's having a little bit of trouble. You see, there's this "bad egg" fella who's screwing with Gian and kidnapping all of his friends. How is Gian going to rescue them? By going on an epic board game journey, that's how!

[From The Yaoi Treasure Trove]
